title: Plan of Actions on Jointly Building a China-Africa Community with a Shared Future in Cyberspace (2025-2026)
authority_note: Primary official CAC policy document (English translation).
claims: Implements the 2021 China-Africa cyberspace initiative and the FOCAC Beijing Action Plan (2025-2027)

Digital economy actions: 5G/submarine cable cooperation, 'Cooperation Network of Chinese Internet Enterprises in Africa', Silk Road E-Commerce campaign to market 100 African stores and 1,000 African products
Digital capacity building via China-Africa Exchange and Cooperation Center on Cybersecurity and Digital Economy; annual seminars; AI talent cultivation
AI governance action: put the Global AI Governance Initiative into practice with Africa; coordinate with African countries on global AI governance rules via UN/G20/BRICS
draft_usage: Cited for the China-Africa digital/cyberspace cooperation plan and its AI governance action under Social (Global South).
